name: NanoMap GPU-Accelerated Occupancy Mapping
definition: A probabilistic mapping solution that encodes dense point clouds into OpenVDB data structures by off-loading computationally expensive filtering and ray-casting operations to a CUDA-compatible GPU, while leveraging OpenVDB's sparse grid structure for memory efficiency and fast CPU-side operations.
summary: NanoMap is a GPU-accelerated mapping solution that encodes dense point clouds into OpenVDB structures, leveraging CUDA parallelism to overcome CPU bottlenecks for real-time occupancy updates.
